Home.badge: Author & Founding Editor: M. Thayalan (எம். தயாளன்)
Home.heroTitle: Manjary (மஞ்சரி) — The Living Pulse of Tamil Literature
Home.heroDescription: A dedicated literary home for evocative short stories, serialized novels, and emerging Tamil writers around the world.
Home.authorBioP1: M. Thayalan is an acclaimed Tamil fiction writer and editor whose stories capture the fragrance of native soil, generational memory, and the quiet resilience of the human spirit across the diaspora.
Home.authorBioP2: Driven by a commitment to mentor and publish aspiring writers, he founded 'Manjary' (மஞ்சரி) as an inclusive literary journal where new voices are published alongside seasoned masters.

Manjary.title: Manjary (மஞ்சரி) Literary Magazine
Manjary.subtitle: An Open Door for Aspiring Tamil Writers — Edited by M. Thayalan
Manjary.missionText: Manjary was founded with a singular mission: to discover, mentor, and publish aspiring Tamil writers who long for a welcoming literary stage. Every issue pairs established literary voices with carefully edited debut stories, poems, and critical essays.
Manjary.guideline1: Short stories should be 1,000–3,500 words typed in clean Tamil Unicode.
Manjary.guideline2: Submissions must be original, previously unpublished works in print or digital media.
Manjary.guideline3: First-time authors receive constructive editorial notes and guidance from M. Thayalan's editorial desk.
Manjary.pricingSubtitle: Support independent Tamil literature and emerging writers by choosing a membership tier
